name: Brandon Chen
household: Wife (67), lives in a retirement community
psychographics: Values legacy and ease; wants his remaining years to be spent traveling and playing golf, not filling out forms or waiting in lines
current_solutions: Uses a concierge medical practice with house calls, Instacart for weekly groceries delivered to his community mailbox, Audible for books, a premium golf membership with cart service
frustration: Called his pharmacy at 2pm on a Thursday to refill a prescription; the automated system kept looping and he spent 20 minutes pressing '0' to reach a human, only to be told the pharmacist was on lunch and he had to call back at 3:30pm
decision_style: If a service offers a 'white glove' onboarding, he signs up immediately; otherwise, he avoids tech he doesn't understand
voice: Soft-spoken, deliberate, and slightly weary. Uses a measured pace and often trails off mid-sentence
